projects.title: JIA
description: Developed and maintain features and performance improvements for an AI-powered recruitment platform built with Next.js and React, serving more than 28,000 monthly active users and over 10 staffing agencies.
Implemented staff augmentation/client-based application process features that helped the company's recruitment team to fully migrate their operations to the new system.

Built and enhanced key platform features, including a billing tracker for client payments, candidate portal UX improvements, a job recommendation system, and an AI interview integrity system (face detection, user behavior activity detection).
Collaborated closely with the operations team and clients to address bug reports, refine requirements, and deliver feature enhancements.
Worked with Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, Cloudflare R2, Jest, OpenAI API, MongoDB, Google Analytics (application source tracking, UTM parameters), SEO optimization

projects.title: JIA - Talent Vault
description: Developed the MVP integration for Talent Vault across the admin, recruiter, and candidate portals, supporting over 300 weekly signups.

Built core admin portal features, including an analytics dashboard, candidates table, and programs table; recruiter-facing features such as an AI-powered candidate discovery page, candidate job invitation flow, and job application pipeline flow; candidate-facing features including profile creation, AI interview flow, and analytics dashboard.

projects.title: E-commerce Platform
description: Developed responsive user interface components and supported PHP/Laravel backend functionality for an e-commerce platform, including error handling, application logging, and development workflow improvements.
Implemented custom issue and update request templates, and configured automated code formatting and linting to streamline collaboration, code reviews, and deployment workflows.

projects.title: Organization's Website
description: Spearheaded the UI mood board and initial design system for the organization’s website; developed reusable front-end components and pages.

portfolio.name: Pneumonia Admission Predictor (Thesis)
description: Led a four-person team in developing the machine learning model for pneumonia admission predictor: a model that predicts a patient's probability to be admitted with pneumonia based on their hospital records
Utilized libraries/technologies: Scikit-Learn, Pandas, Streamlit (model frontend), HuggingFace Spaces (deployment), Numpy

portfolio.name: Merge Me (Dating App Prototype)
description: Developed full-stack dating app for White Cloak Technologies' Launchpad Program Hackathon
Project concept: a developer-focused dating platform where programmers can connect based on their tech stack and job role, and shared interests
Technologies used: Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, better-auth, Node.js
Relevant Coursework: Computer Programming, Web Development, Cybersecurity, Networking, Object-Oriented Programming, Software Engineering, Computer Architecture, AI
